treatment_summary: The patient’s metabolic‑syndrome‑driven hypertension is managed with continuation of lisinopril, replacement of HCTZ by indapamide, and addition of amlodipine to achieve BP <140/90 mmHg (NG136). Cardiovascular risk is reduced with atorvastatin 20 mg (CG181). Prediabetes is addressed with metformin after confirming renal function (PH38). Severe anxiety is treated with sertraline (CG168). Weight management is supported by orlistat and structured lifestyle advice. All drug choices follow NICE recommendations, interactions have been reviewed, contraindicated agents avoided, and monitoring plans established.
